title: Chapter 772
paragraphs: Chapter 772
Episode 190. Mariet Hister's Succession Site (2)
Whooosh-!
The magical wind formed by Valeria gently wrapped around the two of them.
They landed on the ground at ease, smoothing out their clothing.
"So, pushing us like this is the beginning of the traps in the Succession Site, what a fun creature. Just like your ancestor, Mariet."
Nodding, Valeria touched the wall.
As if she wanted to directly feel the legacy left by her ancestor.
The wall was made of a mineral as transparent as crystal, and magical energy was gently flowing inside it.
If she were the old Valeria, and if she had come here alone, she would never have done this.
She could have triggered a trap by touching the wall.
But now, she was reassured that no matter what happened, Jin was with her.
Jin smiled, reading her thoughts.
"This place feels different from the Succession Sites we've visited so far."
"How so?"
"Usually, the moment we enter, the Succession Sites have a sacred aura that makes one feel solemn. But here, I feel as if someone is playfully watching us."
"Really? Despite its reputation for being brutal, Mariet seems like she might have been a good person."
In his previous life, Jin had never heard the name Mariet from Valeria.
That is to say, this was a Succession Site that Valeria in her previous life hadn't found.
'I hope there's something more that can be of great help to my master, aside from the communication device that Zen Lutberg made. Perhaps there are records or magic left by Mariet.'
Looking around, he saw a short path drawn out.
At the end of the path was a fork in the road.
"We're met with a fork right from the start. Which way should we go?"
Valeria lightly waved her yew wand, forming a record window.
She was intending to check the records to see which path was the correct one.
However, the last record left in this space was more than three hundred years old, and there was some kind of interference.
"It seems our ancestor Mariet made it difficult to easily check the records."
"So, you're saying we have to guess."
"Let's try the left path first."
As the two of them entered the left entrance, a ominous noise came from afar.
The sound and vibration of what seemed like a huge mass of iron rolling quickly towards them.
Kuguguguguguk-!
In reality, it was a metal ball about the size of a young dragon's body.
If you have the combat power to barely beat Honka, the best strategy would be to turn around and run.
Jin reflexively clenched his fist to smash the iron ball, then remembered Honka's words.
So, instead of breaking the iron ball, he spread out his palm and stopped it.
Thud-!
The iron ball came to a halt, causing a heavy noise.
"The slope of the path the ball rolled down is quite steep. This, somehow, seems like a device meant to force us to enter the right side?"
Jin commented.
Valeria seemed to be having the same thoughts.
They left the iron ball and tried entering through the right entrance, indeed, a trap of a lower level than the iron ball was triggered.
Just a few stones being shot out was all.
"It seems so. If we're deliberately made to choose the easier side, the possibility of this being the real path is higher."
They decided to return to the left and continue.
Jin used all his strength to push up the iron ball, opening the path.
And when they got about halfway up the path, they found a hole in the ground.
The iron ball couldn't fall into it, but a person could fit easily.
"Seems like a shortcut?"
"Yeah, probably."
As they fell through the hole, the landscape of a vast cavern opened up immediately.
And the two immediately recognized that this cavern was being used as some kind of 'battlefield'.
From the floor and walls to the ceiling, traces of battle were everywhere.
There were marks from swords, the remnants of stray magic, and scratches like something had been gouged out.
"[Gruh, ooh, invasion, arrival......3 minutes......24 seconds. New record, renewal. Average, 78 hours 13 minutes, extremely fast. Superhuman or higher, strong......]"
This time it really was a golem.
Jin and Valeria turned their heads toward where the golem's voice came from.
A golem with a similar physique to Jin, and a similar shape to a human, was seen awkwardly moving, its yellow eyes twinkling.

'78 hours? So, if you can't use the shortcut, that's the typical amount of time required? But more than that, it has this level of judgement and intelligence despite not seeming to be a living golem?'
In his previous life, and in this one, he had never heard of such a golem.
"[Honka...... survival, confirmation. Succession Site damage, none. Red, hair, complete, magical body. Hister. Confirmation. Maximum armament, 1st class hostility not applied.]"
The golem spoke in a slow and muffled voice.
Screech-!
Suddenly, rune characters appeared all over the golem's body, and an enormous amount of magical power began to be released.
Jin was more astonished by the golem's intelligence than its magic power.
[Transcendent, the final...... test begins. Cry out if you feel like you're going to die. Surrender.]
Just after the golem finished speaking, transformative spells they had never seen before started to pour out.
Jin and Valeria simultaneously formed a shield, not to avoid getting hurt, but to examine the golem's spells.
It was astonishing that a golem could use such high-level magic.
The golem said to shout for surrender if they feel like dying, but the two observed the transformative spells with ease within their shield for a while.
This was possible because of Jin.
If they had been knights or magicians of about 8-star, they would have never avoided struggling, and there was a high probability of ultimate defeat.
"Your ancestor was a formidable person."
"I'm shocked too."
Honka had said that he regarded the traps set up by Mallet in the succession site as works of art, among which the golem must have been the masterpiece.
"This spell is...... a transformation of Hellwind? The flow has been altered appropriately. The timing of the release of magic is especially surprising."

"The setting to cast it along with the Burst Flame Orb is impressive. And seeing the casting speed is on the level of the First Movements Spear holder, it's probably firing off the magic stored in the rune characters."
"Store magic in rune characters...... It's theoretically possible, but can so many high-level spells be stored like this?"
"It's impossible in the way that ordinary wizards use. I think it's a modification of the Record Magic. It's imbued with the attribute of storage."
As Valeria said, all the magic of the golem were ones that Mallet used in his lifetime.
Mallet had 'recorded and stored' his own magic into the golem.

"Record and storage...... If this can be made into a coalition technology, all the knights of the coalition might be able to fight like a Mage Knight. Even if they don't have even 1-star level magic power, they just need to use the stored magic at the appropriate moment."
Surprisingly, it wasn't Jin who said this, but Valeria.
Jin stared at the side of Valeria's face, his eyes wide open.
Suddenly, Jin remembered that in his past life, he enjoyed looking at Valeria's profile like this.

"Of course, it won't compare to a real Mage Knight like you, but all the knights' combat abilities would drastically increase. If we can research it, it could be as significant a discovery as the communication device we've been looking for."
So, they spent about ten minutes talking inside the shield.
By that time, the golem's magic seemed to have run out, as its firepower was noticeably weaker than at first.
[10 minutes 32 seconds, elapsed, magic used, 871. Effective hits, 0. Test...... is over, Transcendent.]
Soon, the golem spoke with its glow fading.
When Jin and Valeria removed their shields, the golem put its left hand on its chest and bowed.
[Please, follow. It's time to see... the world of... the master.]
Jin and Valeria followed the golem, their eyes fixed on its retreating figure.
Up close, its intricate and complex structure was even more striking.
A few minutes later, a massive door stretching up to the ceiling appeared.
[I must inform you in advance.]
"About what? Something we should take note of?"

[There are deceased individuals within, who have overlaid themselves onto the inheritance site and remain as records. They are previous passers, unstable but harmless. Also, they do not represent your future, as long as you do not make the same choices.]
"Could one of them be Zen Rutberg?"
At Valeria's question, the golem nodded.
What was written in the letter was not metaphorical, but a literal explanation.
[Yes, and Teben Hister.]
"Teben Hister... So that's the name of the ancestor who wrote this letter. Got it. But what's your name?"
Rumble, rumble...
The golem did not answer, but placed its palm in a groove in the middle of the door.
A magical reaction occurred across the entire door, illuminating it.
The door slowly opened to reveal the end of the inheritance site.
An expansively wide-open space like the ocean on a clear day, and hundreds of blue dots floating within it.
Each dot was a record window.
As the golem described, they were the essence of the records left by Mariett Hister, which could be referred to as 'Mariett Hister's world'.
Overwhelmed, Valeria became reverent in an instant, but before she could fully appreciate the moment, another new voice sounded.
[Oh, oh wow! A living person, a new one!]
[Finally, a descendant has come...!]
It was the voices of Teben and Zen.
Although they appeared blurry like ghosts, they were excited enough to be recognized from afar.
Valeria was the first to bow respectfully to them.
Thanks to her recent familiarity with meeting the deceased, she wasn't overly taken aback.
"Nice to meet you, ancestors. I am Valeria Hister."
"I'm Jin Runcandel."
Instead of replying, Teben and Zen smiled broadly and immediately threw a question at the two of them.
[You guys!]
[Did you also do all those strange things with the elephant trunk when you entered here!?]
It wasn't the sort of question one would typically ask when meeting new people after 350 years, but it seemed like a very important issue for Zen and Teben.
Watching Zen and Teben, the golem rested its hand on its forehead.
